subject: Initial request: SOC 2 Type II report and delivery options
messages:
From: Alicia Romero <alicia.romero@novahost.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@novahost.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for SOC 2 Type II report and evidence transfer options

Hi Jasmine,

We're kicking off a vendor security review for Redwood as part of our procurement intake for NovaHost. Could you send us Redwood's most recent SOC 2 Type II report and let us know the best way to transfer supplemental artifacts? Our compliance team would like:

- The SOC 2 Type II report (PDF)
- A bridge letter if the report doesn't cover the current date
- An evidence index (mapping control IDs to examples)
- Guidance on acceptable delivery methods (SFTP, secure Drive link, presigned S3) and redaction expectations

Target timeline: we'd like an initial bundle by July 10 so the InfoSec team can review before our July 17 risk meeting.

Also confirm point of contact for any follow-ups or to request specific artifacts (logs, policy snapshots, system diagrams).

Thanks,

Alicia Romero
Senior Vendor Manager
NovaHost
procurement@novahost.com

Attachments: none
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for SOC 2 Type II report and evidence transfer options

Hi Alicia — thanks for the note and the timeline. Happy to help; outline below to make this low friction.

Quick summary
- We can provide our most recent SOC 2 Type II report (audit period: 2027-01-01 to 2027-12-31).
- If you need assurance past the report date, we can issue a bridge letter that documents there were no material control changes through the date of issuance.
- We also provide an evidence index sample to show the typical artifacts we can surface.

Attachments included in this reply (samples):
- SOC2-TypeII-20270101-20271231-report.pdf (the report PDF)
- SOC2-bridge-letter-sample.pdf (example bridge letter text)
- evidence-index-sample.csv (sample mapping of controls to artifact names)
- secure-upload-instructions.txt (options and who to contact)

Delivery options (pick one):
1) Secure Drive folder (link with restricted viewers, preferred for most vendors)
2) Short-lived S3 presigned URLs for individual artifacts (we can provide per-file links)
3) Managed SFTP endpoint (for larger evidence bundles)

Redaction guidance
- You may redact customer PII from artifacts; indicate redactions in the filename or via a redaction log.
- We will not redact control attestations in the SOC report itself.

Timeline estimate
- Report + bridge letter: 1-2 business days after you confirm delivery preference.
- Evidence index and sample artifacts: 3-5 business days to assemble the selected items.

Next steps
- Please confirm which delivery option you prefer and whether your team needs executed copies (signed) of the bridge letter/report.
- Share the email(s) of the reviewers who need Drive access or the SFTP ingestion account.

If helpful, Marissa (cc'd) can handle the evidence index and the secure transfer. David is available for technical questions about telemetry/log exports.

Best,

Jasmine Liu
Senior Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0178

Thanks, Jasmine — that is helpful. A couple quick clarifications before we lock in the delivery method:

- Our security team prefers assurance that covers the most recent 12 months where possible. Will the bridge letter effectively extend coverage from 2027-12-31 to the bridge issuance date (we're hoping for coverage through end of July)?
- Can you provide S3 presigned links? Our intake automation pulls artifacts from presigned URLs directly.
- For redaction: are there any artifact types you recommend we avoid asking for (e.g., raw customer PII in logs)?

If you can confirm the answers and provision presigned links to a small sample (evidence-index-sample.csv + 2 artifact samples), we'll ingest and let you know if we need more.

Alicia
Senior Vendor Manager
NovaHost

Hi Alicia — following up with specifics.

Audit coverage and bridge letter
- The SOC 2 Type II report we provided covers 2027-01-01 through 2027-12-31.
- Our bridge letter can be issued with a statement of no material control changes through the date of issuance; we typically date the bridge letter the day we generate it. If you need explicit coverage through July 31, please confirm and we will date/issue the bridge letter accordingly.

Presigned links and sample artifacts
- We can generate short-lived S3 presigned URLs for the specific artifacts you request. Example (placeholder): https://s3-presigned.redwood.example.com/NH-47821/sample-evidence-1?X-Amz-Expires=3600
- We'll upload the evidence-index-sample.csv and two sample artifacts to a restricted Drive folder and also provide presigned links if you'd prefer automation.

Redaction guidance
- Do not request raw customer PII in bulk. For logs, we recommend requesters ask for redacted excerpts or aggregated telemetry.
- If you require unredacted artifacts for a specific control, we can discuss a supervised review process under an NDA and limited access.

Delivery and security controls
- Options: restricted Drive link (preferred), S3 presigned URLs, managed SFTP.
- All artifacts at rest are encrypted (AES-256) and transfer links are time-limited.
- We have a standard DPA; if you need our DPA template I can share it.

Next steps
1) Confirm bridge letter coverage through July 31, 2028 (yes/no).
2) Confirm preferred delivery method (Drive or S3 presigned).
3) Provide reviewer emails for Drive access or an automated ingestion endpoint for presigned URLs.

If those three items look good, we'll send the presigned links and the final bridge letter within one business day.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Director, Compliance
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: none (we will push requested samples to the secure folder once you confirm)
